body:
What about something like this:

> Returns [code]true[/code] if [method atr] and [method atr_n] can translate messages depending on the current locale. See also [member auto_translate_mode].
>
> Many built-in nodes like [Label] and [Button] automatically change their displayed text content on locale changes when they can auto translate. Being able to auto translate also makes the texts in the node candidates for the POT generator.

Regarding "affect", my opinion is that this description describes a getter. The action of retrieving information does not affect anything. What can influence those strings is the value of `auto_translate_mode`.

> The other line you wrote sounds more worthy to mention in `auto_translate_mode`'s description, which I believe is somewhat done already?
